Dwarfcraft Devices browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Dwarfcraft Devices Bit Mangler Published on October 6, 2009 Dwarfcraft Devices fuzz pedal design design Information Dwarfcraft Devices The Dwarfcraft Bit Mangler distortion effect pedal, pairs the wicked Bit fuzz, an extremely cruel and loud circuit, with the smooth octave up and grinding lows of the Vintage Fuzz Master. Both fuzzes have chaos and noise modes available, and the intensity of each is controlled by the stombox's great big joystick. Formerly produced by Devi Ever USA, the Bit Mangler pedal rips your guitar tone into a new and exciting chaotic noise masterpiece.
